question: The average weight of a class of 30 students is 45 kg. One of the students whose weight is 48.5 kg is replaced by another student and the average weight was increased by 200 g. Find the weight of the new student.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total increase in weight = 30 × 200 g = 6000 g = 6 kg

Weight of new student = Weight of replaced student + Total increase

New weight = 48.5 kg + 6 kg = 54.5 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 54.5 kg.**
